description: This is a test class for MessageFactory, focusing on date-time formatting and parsing, including custom formatting and compatibility checks.

classes.name: MessageFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing date-time formatting and parsing in MessageFactory.

methods.name: formatterTest
methods.description: Tests the custom ISO local date-time formatter to ensure it formats LocalDateTime instances with microsecond precision, including trailing zeros.

methods.name: backParsingTest
methods.description: Verifies that date-time strings formatted with the custom formatter can be parsed back into LocalDateTime objects accurately, maintaining compatibility with the standard ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME formatter.
